description: This file defines the Xls class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for calculating cell dimensions, distances, and coordinate conversions specific to XLS file manipulation.

classes.name: Xls
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for calculating dimensions and coordinate conversions in XLS spreadsheet files.

methods.name: sizeCol
methods.description: Calculates the width of a specific column in pixels based on default font and column dimension settings.

methods.name: sizeRow
methods.description: Calculates the height of a specific row in pixels, considering default and custom row dimensions.

methods.name: getDistanceX
methods.description: Calculates the horizontal pixel distance between two anchor points in the worksheet.

methods.name: getDistanceY
methods.description: Calculates the vertical pixel distance between two anchor points in the worksheet.

methods.name: oneAnchor2twoAnchor
methods.description: Converts 1-cell anchor coordinates to 2-cell anchor coordinates for positioning images or objects within the worksheet.
